surprises.head: Winnipeg won without the better chances
surprises.body: Expected goals favoured Detroit, 4.3 to 2.6, with empty nets left out. S. Skinner stopped 2.3 more goals than expected.

surprises.head: Detroit tried a different line
surprises.body: J. Compher, K. Kolesar, M. Rasmussen played 6:49 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Detroit’s usual lines.
